title: Site Envelope
description: The measured physical, tenure and contextual constraints of a registered place. Additive to existing records — nullable during Phase 1 backfill. title_area_m2 is recorded for context only and MUST NOT be read by any scoring function.

growing_area_m2.description: Planted substrate area. NOT land or title area.

title_area_m2.description: CONTEXT ONLY. Never enters EP, EC or LO. Present so the wealth-neutrality claim is auditable.

vertical_envelope_m.description: Unobstructed height available to vegetation. This, not area, determines canopy feasibility.

urban_matrix_class.description: Derived from open data. Not steward-entered.

envelope_source.description: Verified records require assessor_verified. Anti-gaming control.

envelope_evidence.description: Photo/document references supporting declared constraints (slab photo, strata rules, load certificate).

$comment: REVIEW TRIGGER: any revision that reduces a constraint field (growing_area_m2, vertical_envelope_m, permission_scope) AND increases EP must be held for review before publication. Downward envelope revision is the primary fraud path.
